description: (needs account token) Returns a payment link that turns on email for a site's own domain (a main inbox such as hello@yourdomain.com, €5 / $5 a month, including VAT in the EU). It is a mailbox that sends and receives. The account holder opens and pays the link. After payment the mailbox and its DNS records are set up. Mail is read and sent in the DropTheHassle webmail, or in a mail app over IMAP and SMTP with the settings and password shown in the dashboard. A saved card is not charged. The site needs an active domain registered here first.

address.description: The part before the @ of the main inbox, e.g. "hello". Default hello.

site.description: The address of the site whose domain gets email, for example myproject.dropthehassle.app.
